subject: Request: Founders Sandbox credit transfer & packaging exception
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@nestventures.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on Founders Sandbox credits

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Two quick questions from our finance / platform team as we scope the PoC: 1) The Founders Sandbox credits you mentioned — can those be applied to Dedicated deployments (we need strict data isolation for a subset of workloads)? And 2) does Redwood allow credits to be re-assigned between projects within our org or rolled forward if we don't consume them within 90 days?

We have an SOW draft attached for context (SOW references hosted API). If credits can't be applied across packaging variants, we'll need to surface that to legal now.

Appreciate a short note so we can loop procurement — Linda

Attachments: NestVenture_SOW_v1.pdf

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@nestventures.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Founders Sandbox credits

Hi Linda — thanks for flagging. Short answers up front: Dedicated is normally outside promo-credit applicability, but we can make an exception for accelerator partners with a documented carve-out. Credits can be re-assigned between projects under the same org; rollover is a special-case (default is 90 days).

Next steps I propose: 1) Ben (finance) to confirm accounting treatment for carve-outs, 2) Marissa (ops) to confirm billing flow and how we represent credits on invoices, and 3) I’ll draft a short amendment to the SOW that grants the sandbox credit to the specified HW/packaging variants.

If you’re ok, I’ll loop the internal approvers and share a one-paragraph amendment that legal/procurement can sign.

—Jonas

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Linda Park <linda@nestventures.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Founders Sandbox credits

Jonas / Linda — I reviewed the promo ledger and the program playbook. Operationally we can mark credits to apply to Dedicated nodes, but two things to call out for accounting: 1) If credits are applied against Dedicated (reserved capacity), revenue recognition might shift from usage-based to more of a committed-capacity concession — we’ll need to document that in the amendment to preserve audit trails. 2) Rollover beyond 90 days requires a carve-out in our promotion policy and approval from RevOps.

I’ve attached the current promo-credit ledger and a suggested sentence for the SOW amendment that ties credit application to the SOW line item and the HubSpot deal (link below).

Ben

Attachments: promo-credit-ledger.csv

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Linda Park <linda@nestventures.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Founders Sandbox credits

Adding ops context — we can implement the credit mapping two ways: 1) map credits to a billing line item that targets Dedicated SKU IDs (cleanest for invoices), or 2) create a project-level credit pool and let Nest allocate across projects (more flexible but requires tagging discipline). For the SOW amendment I recommend the billing-line approach so accounting/tax is straightforward.

Draft amendment text (for SOW):
"Redwood will provide Nest Ventures with $25,000 in Founders Sandbox credits. These credits may be applied to both Hosted API and Dedicated Reserved Capacity SKUs for the account NV-2026-142. Credits will be recorded on invoices as a line-item deduction against the affected SKU. Unused credits expire after 180 days unless a subsequent written amendment is signed."

If everyone agrees, I’ll produce a tracked-change SOW and a short one-paragraph addendum for procurement to sign.

Marissa

From: Linda Park <linda@nestventures.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Founders Sandbox credits

Thanks — that language looks good. A few questions from procurement: can we get the credit expiry extended to 270 days instead of 180, and can the amendment include a clause allowing one-time re-assignment of credits to a partner project outside our org (we may spin a partner proof-of-concept)? If that requires extra approvals, please let me know what form is needed.

Also cc’ing Kyle (finance at Nest) — Kyle, are you ok with the accounting path Jonas/Ben outlined?

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@nestventures.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Founders Sandbox credits

Linda / Kyle — extending to 270 days is doable but requires RevOps sign-off and a one-time manual ledger flag (we’ll have to treat these as extended promos for audit). Re-assignment outside the org is not standard because of invoicing and tax complexities, but we can offer a limited option: a one-time partner-pass-through where Redwood issues credits to Nest, and Nest issues equivalent credits to the named partner; this will require a short amendment and a partner acknowledgment form.

If Nest is comfortable with that process, I can kick off RevOps approval and draft the amendment + partner acknowledgment template. Jonas/Marissa — I’ll need the HubSpot deal ID and the SOW file we discussed.

Ben

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6523412
Attachments referenced: foundry-sandbox-terms-2026.xlsx
